digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and completion close path
propositions: A CODE-VERIFIABLE acceptance criterion tagged [operator-attested] with repository evidence (exact path/symbol in commit) bypassed the plan-review guards and was accepted at close by the completion verifier, because the evidence-kind criterion failed to detect the mistagging and the provenance detector was wired ADVISORY-only

The evidence-kind routing overlay ran but returned no finding for AC-19 despite its tagged text citing tests/unit/test_scan_scoping.py verbatim, indicating an LLM judgment miss with no deterministic backstop

The det_measurement_provenance detector flagged missing provenance lines for both tagged ACs but was wired ADVISORY (p6_ac_quality contract), so it surfaced as coaching and did not block the PASS verdict
A tagged AC lacking a provenance: continuation line and citing repository code/test paths must be rejected at close before the completion verifier runs, enforced deterministically and fail-closed
